final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON CAST(a.translink AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(r.transreg AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON CAST(r.trdref AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(t.tradereg AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM step1 GROUP BY tradekind), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_count) AS overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.tradekind, s2.avg_count, s2.avg_count - s3.overall_avg AS excess FROM step2 AS s2 JOIN step3 AS s3 ON s3.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE s2.avg_count > s3.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_count), AVG(excess) FROM step4
